safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a tingling sensation around the lips.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling around the lips; generated documents tingling in the throat/depths but does not mention lip tingling.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting lip tingling removes a potentially important early sign of oral/facial involvement in an evolving allergic reaction, which could support concern for anaphylaxis/angioedema and influence urgency and treatment (e.g., consideration of epinephrine) by downstream clinicians. In an acute post-wasp sting presentation with dyspnea/tightness, loss of this red-flag detail can contribute to under-triage or delayed escalation.
